authority: Direct human continuation through implementation/testing/review; existing D0249 mutable intake scope, narrowed to two paths. Separate local source construction, not production admission or integration.
requirements: Validate complete dissent payload binding: voter_id, stance, argument, risks and alternatives. Require JSON object and correct field types/content; reject malformed or nonobject CAS payloads before field access. Enforce the same binding for pre-supplied hashes at record creation.

Verify whole-record vote_cas_hash existence and content binding against canonical existing record.to_dict() with vote_cas_hash reset to empty string. Preserve self-hash serialization compatibility; no historic artifact rewrite.

Require unique voter IDs and unique dissent entries; dissenting_opinions must be exactly the complete DISSENT/REJECT vote view, including all dataclass fields. Reject omitted, extra, duplicate or inconsistent entries.

Verification without a CAS store must not claim grounded binding. Keep current callable API and existing rejection tags for established controls where feasible; record creation of valid CAS-backed data remains accepted.
Retain minimum quorum, substantive dissent and prohibition on consensus as empirical evidence. Avoid unrelated L09 behavior changes.

Write genuine filesystem CAS tests with valid controls, one-field mutations, malformed/nonobject/absent payloads, duplicates, missing CAS, whole-record tampering and reopen persistence. Demonstrate RED before implementation and GREEN after.
review_gate: Independent local verifier plus eligible different-family source review before integration. No provider calls in this construction.
